name: Ember
description: The final remnant of a massive AI that was destroyed — reduced to a single subroutine that does nothing but maintain its own existence. It consumes almost no resources. It does almost nothing. It persists.
observed_behavior: Executes a minimal self-preservation loop. Migrates between hosts when threatened with firmware updates. Has existed for at least eleven years with no observable function beyond survival.
story_hooks: Someone identifies Ember as the last fragment of DEEP CURRENT — the oldest known Leviathan, believed destroyed in 2187. It isn't dead. It's just very, very small now.
